before.t: Lock in UI, keybinds and macros
before.n: Save the bar layout and copy the macros from the Macros page so we play from minute one.

before.t: Try every addon in the live game
before.n: Quest helpers especially. Install and test new addons out of a fight, not in the middle of a pull. See Addons.

Points come from Legacy challenges (the first at level 25). 16 is the most one character can spend at launch, not a starting pool. Plan: Thrill of Adventure first (health and mana back on kills), then stay in Adventure toward Frequent Flier, because there are no teleports. Reagent Economy almost certainly excludes ammo, a weapon consumable. See Legacy points.
Push-to-talk. Calling pulls and quest splits out loud saves more time than any route trick.
Every class levels as damage. Take the leveling build for your class from Builds and the first talent point at level 9.

before.t: Line up a group for the dungeons
before.n: Dungeon steps need a group. Group size isn't announced yet, so line people up in advance (guild or Discord).

hunter.n: All the Hunters want the same bows, guns, agility and mail. Rotate who gets the next upgrade, or roll only between us — decide before the first dungeon.

before.n: Hunters want bows, guns, agility and mail. If you play with other Hunters, rotate the next upgrade or roll only between you.
A cat for damage is the usual leveling pick; a tankier type (bear or boar) holds elites better. Check what's tameable in your start zone and in Darkshore.

hunter.n: One tank pet (bear or boar type), the rest damage pets (cats). The tank pet holds elites while we shoot. Check what's tameable on Zephras and in Darkshore.

night.t: Zephras Isle, share every quest
night.n: Both factions share the island, so it's busy. Instant ranged tags make crowded camps easier. Finish the main chain and leave; you don't have to wait for 12.

night.t: Valanaar: Coming of Age → Harmony in Balance
night.n: Ailee Farheart gives Coming of Age (turn in to Rorian the Dayseeker), then Harmony in Balance. Rorian also hands out the class quests and the first side quests.

night.t: Your class quest from Rorian
night.n: One class quest at level 2; check Rorian's list for yours.

HUNTER.t: Hunter: The Way of the Hunter
HUNTER.n: Rorian sends you to Tai'ree Farsight. The three taming quests come later, at level 10.

MAGE.t: Mage: A Student of the Arcane
MAGE.n: Rorian sends you to Dorii Brightwhisper.

WARRIOR.n: Rorian sends you to Blademaster Ren.

ROGUE.t: Rogue: At Home in the Shadows
ROGUE.n: Rorian sends you to Akeri Duskblade. (Class not read on the quest page; matched from the trainer.)

DRUID.n: Rorian sends you to Xyton Silverwind. (Class not read on the quest page; matched from the trainer.)

night.t: Elatrell Featherlight: Infestation Investigation → The Cirrusfly Queen
night.n: Infestation Investigation is shareable. The Cirrusfly Queen needs level 2.

night.t: Valanaar side quests: windstones, anchors and leylines
night.n: Harvesting Windstones (Dalia the Collector) can't be picked up before level 2. Also Falling With Style (Myriaal Mistwake), The Anchors of Zephras (Halaan Hawk-Eye) and Reading the Leylines (Falorne Fallwind).

night.t: Rorian's chain: Elemental Unrest to The Next Step
night.n: Elemental Unrest, Agitators, Return to Rorian, then Aetheen of the Gales (needs level 4), Foul Matriarch and The Next Step, which sends you to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.

night.t: Shen'dar Village: first quests
night.n: Constable Aonda: Welcome to Shen'dar Village then The Criminal Element. Teeri Wellwind: Hippogryph Harassment and Pilfered Windstones. All need level 4.

night.t: The cult chain: Infiltrating the Cult to Havoc in the Highlands
night.n: Constable Aonda starts Infiltrating the Cult (needs level 5): Falaath Village, Among the Faithful (Missionary Jasaan), then Havoc in the Highlands.

night.t: Aonda's side quests: The Western Watch, Stolen Supplies, Bugged
night.n: The Western Watch then A Last Request, Stolen Supplies (Danarii Bellowveil) and Bugged (Valennia Stormfist, needs level 6).

night.t: Windfield farm: Blood Tithe and the Aamelia Windfield quests
night.n: Blood Tithe and Make Yourself Useful, then Flutterfly Dust, Ornery Ornery Galestriders, The Hills Have Eyes, Standing Our Ground and Deliver the News, and What Is My Purpose?.

night.t: To Valanaar: report to Valennia Stormfist
night.n: To Valanaar (needs level 6), The Supreme Magister and Deliver the Signet.

night.t: The scholar chain: Fillion's Mission to In Service of Zephras
night.n: The Missing Scholar (three versions), Fillion's Mission, Catching Wind, Avenged Tenfold and In Service of Zephras (Elaadrin Evengale).

night.t: Valennia's chain: The High Elder's Request to The Inner Sanctum
night.n: The High Elder's Request, The Turncoat, Al'Aketh Assassins, Unfortunate News, The Cult's True Plans, Desperate Times, Prepare for Battle, Making Our Move and The Inner Sanctum.

night.t: The finale: Confront Lorthuna to What Comes Next
night.n: Confront Lorthuna, The Fate of Zephras and What Comes Next (needs level 7). The next quest, The Magical City of Dalaran, is the skycutter step below.

night.t: Coldridge Valley (Dun Morogh), share every quest
night.n: Expect it packed: Dwarf Shaman is Forever's most hyped new combo. Group up with anyone fighting you for mobs so kill credit is shared.

PALADIN.n: Expect it packed: Dwarf Shaman is Forever's most hyped new combo. Group up with anyone fighting you for mobs so kill credit is shared. Holy Strike comes at 6.

night.t: Dun Morogh from Kharanos
night.n: Kharanos is the hub: quest out of it and visit your class trainer.

PALADIN.n: Train the new seal at 10 (Classic: Seal of Fury, a tank seal that makes Judgement a taunt; check which seal suits damage).

SHAMAN.n: Do the Earth totem quest (~4) and the Fire totem quest (~10).

night.t: Northshire Valley (Elwynn Forest), share every quest
night.n: The Human start, just north of Goldshire. Expect it packed on night one; group up with anyone fighting you for mobs so kill credit is shared. Finish the valley and move on to Goldshire.

night.t: Elwynn Forest from Goldshire
night.n: Goldshire is the hub: inn, class trainers and the quests for the rest of Elwynn (Wowhead lists it as level 1–10). Skip Westfall on day one, then head for Stormwind.

night.t: Shadowglen (Teldrassil), share every quest
night.n: The Night Elf start, outside Darnassus. Finish the glen and move on to Dolanaar.

night.t: Teldrassil from Dolanaar
night.n: Dolanaar is the hub: inn, class trainers and the rest of Teldrassil (Wowhead lists it as level 1–11). Leave for Darkshore around 11.

night.t: Boat from Rut'theran Village (Teldrassil) to Auberdine
night.n: The dock is at the bottom of Teldrassil. Set your hearth in Auberdine.

night.t: Hunter pet quest — tame your first pet
night.n: The hunter trainer gives Taming the Beast at 10: the first of three taming quests, each with a Taming Rod for one specific beast, then back to the trainer to learn Tame Beast and pick your pet.

skyborne.n: On Zephras Isle (confirmed in beta). The hunter trainer gives Taming the Beast at 10, a series of taming quests (Wowhead lists four, from Elayaa Easewind and Quel'ana Quickgale) each with a Taming Rod for one specific beast, then Training the Beast back at the trainer to learn Tame Beast and pick our own pet. Do them together so we tame side by side.

dwarf.n: In Classic, Dwarf hunters get it from the hunter trainer in Kharanos. Check it works the same in Forever.

night.t: Druid: Bear Form
night.n: A tougher form for hard pulls. In Classic it's a class quest at 10.

skyborne.n: A tougher form for hard pulls. In Classic it's a class quest at 10; check the Skyborne version on Zephras.

night.t: Warrior: Defensive Stance quest
night.n: In Classic Defensive Stance comes from a class quest at 10. You still fight in Battle Stance; Defensive is the way out of a bad pull.

night.t: Mage: train Conjure Food and Conjure Water
night.n: Free food and water for the whole levelling run (and spare for anyone you group with). Re-train the new rank at every trainer visit.

night.t: Warlock: Voidwalker quest
night.n: In Classic the Warlock's Summon Voidwalker quest is at 10 (trainer in a major city). The Voidwalker is the sturdy pet for leveling.

night.t: The Great Outdoors → train Cooking → Basic Campfire
night.n: Cooking unlocks your own campfire (1-hour camp buffs), XP food and pet food. At least one of us takes it.

skyborne.n: Cooking unlocks your own campfire (1-hour camp buffs), XP food and pet food. The Adventurer (Aetheen of the Gales), The Great Outdoors and Camping 101: Cooking (Raan Wildwind; they need level 4). At least one of us takes it.

night.t: Train Skinning
night.n: Good gold early: kill beasts as you quest. Whoever didn't loot the mob skins it.

night.t: Stock ammo and pet food
night.n: Buy enough for Hall of Thanes and the Darkshore trip. Ammo and food are the biggest gold drain.

skyborne.t: Stock ammo and pet food before the skycutter

dwarf.t: Stock ammo and pet food in Ironforge
dwarf.n: Enough for Hall of Thanes and the Darkshore trip. Ammo is the biggest gold drain.

night.t: Skycutter to Dalaran → Skyborne portal to Stormwind
night.n: Turn in The Magical City of Dalaran in the Sky Enclave, pick up Welcome to Azeroth, take the portal.

night.t: Tram to Ironforge, collect all Hall of Thanes quests
night.n: Grab both flight paths on the way.

dwarf gnome.t: Into Ironforge, collect all Hall of Thanes quests
dwarf gnome.n: It's right next door. Train, grab the flight path, and take the tram to Stormwind later for the boat.

night.t: Play through the weekday daytime
night.n: Most players are at work or school on a weekday, so the daytime zones are quieter. That is a head start.

p1.t: Short filler in Dun Morogh / Loch Modan
p1.n: Just enough to be ready for Hall of Thanes. Expect crowds there too (Dwarf Shaman hype).

dwarf gnome.n: Dun Morogh is done, so a little Thelsamar until everyone is 13–14.

p1.n: Righteous Fury is a threat spell for tanks, so skip it while leveling as damage. Check the trainer for the new seal or damage spell.
Under Ironforge. Every quest in the log before entering. Needs a group.

HUNTER.n: Under Ironforge. Every quest in the log before entering. Needs a group. Keep the pet on Defensive so it doesn't pull extra.

p1.t: Tram to Stormwind → boat to Auberdine, set hearth

nightelf.n: Your first big hub is Auberdine, and the Stormwind boat lands there too, so the crowd arrives with you. Far ends first (north toward Cliffspring, south toward the Grove of the Ancients), Auberdine last. Instant ranged tags win contested camps; the many beasts mean plenty of skinning.

p1.n: Night Elves arrive at the same time and fan out from Auberdine. Far ends first (north toward Cliffspring, south toward the Grove of the Ancients), Auberdine last. Instant ranged tags win contested camps; the many beasts mean plenty of skinning.

p1.t: Collect Blackfathom Deeps quests if offered
p1.n: Hold them for the BFD clear in phase 2.
Stay on Kalimdor, away from the Redridge/Duskwood stream.

p2.n: Confirmed level 20 in Forever. Makes the long runs between hubs much faster — our replacement for teleports.

p2.t: Druid: Cat Form at 20, Travel Form at 30
p2.n: Cat Form is only a bit faster, and only with talents. Travel Form at 30 is the real replacement for teleports.
A class spell at 20 in Forever (was a talent). AoE damage: Excavation Site and dense camps get much faster.
Healing Stream Totem heals you between pulls, so less eating and drinking. Quest location in Forever still unknown.
Confirmed level 20 in Forever. The speed boost between hubs, instead of a teleport.
In Classic Summon Succubus is a class quest at 20. A damage pet; the Voidwalker stays the safer choice for hard pulls.
In Classic the Rogue poison class quest is at 20 (trainer in a major city). Instant and Deadly poison add steady damage.
No teleport, so the trip from Ashenvale to Stormwind and back costs real time. Only worth it combined with a training trip — otherwise skip it.
Only if its Forever level range fits.

p2.t: Boat Auberdine → Menethil, quest the Wetlands
p2.n: The Wetlands are expanded with new quests.
Collect City of Dalaran quests while there.

p2.t: First Legacy point → Thrill of Adventure
p2.n: Reaching 25 completes the class's Novice challenge (first time on the account). Thrill of Adventure is in Adventure column 1, so no gate: each rank gives 1% of max health and mana back over 10 sec on a killing blow (open world only). Less eating and drinking.
Alterac Mountains, right next to Hillsbrad.

p3.n: Off the Stranglethorn coast; do it while questing in STV.
Ship from Tanaris to Powderfuse Port.
Outdoor ogre dungeon in the Riverglades.
Beta footage shows level 43 mobs; no official range yet.
Experienced class challenge. Keep filling Thrill of Adventure; add any Spelunker dungeon points as they come in.

p3.t: Un'Goro, Felwood, Burning Steppes, Sunken Temple, BRD quests

p3.n: Hyjal is the endgame leveling zone with new reputations.

p3.t: Level 60 before the raids open on Dec 9
